query: ThermalCore-88 occupancy-rate logging during the historical 17:00–20:00 maintenance window and whether that outage overlaps the 2024-03-18 14:00 to 2024-03-19 13:00 forecast horizon

evidence.claim: ThermalCore-88 historically had a daily 17:00–20:00 service suspension, but that maintenance will not continue into the forecast period.
evidence.exact_quote: Historically, Unit R4 (ThermalCore-88) underwent a daily maintenance suspension of service between 17:00 and 20:00, but it will not be in maintenance in the future, so this historical maintenance should not affect the forecast period.

evidence.claim: Zero telemetry during maintenance is an observation artifact caused by sensor inactivity.
evidence.exact_quote: 2. TELEMETRY LOGS: The telemetry logs record zero readings due to the lack of sensor activity during these periods.

impacts.rationale: Historical 17:00–20:00 zeros reflect maintenance-related loss of sensor activity rather than true zero highway occupancy. The documents do not provide dated recurrence bounds or the latent occupancy magnitude, so no quantitative correction is justified.

The forecast horizon is governed by an active-monitoring regime without the historical daily maintenance suspension. Forecast methods should therefore avoid reproducing maintenance-induced 17:00–20:00 zeros, but the evidence supplies no numerical occupancy level or change magnitude.
